name: CEPF Indo-Burma Biodiversity Hotspot grants
summary: CEPF small and large grants for civil society organisations conserving biodiversity in the Indo-Burma hotspot (Cambodia, China, Lao PDR, Myanmar, Thailand and Vietnam), run with IUCN Asia as the regional implementation team.
reporting: Large-grant holders file financial reports every quarter and progress reports every six months through CEPF’s online system.
